target_host.description: The hostname or IP address of the upstream UCSPI server. If empty, the proxy expects an incoming client connection via FD 6.

target_port.description: The port number of the upstream server. Only used if target_host is specified.

timeout.description: Connection timeout in seconds for ucspi-proxy when connecting to the target host.

maxline.description: The maximum length of lines (from either server or client) to copy to the log.

verbose.description: If true, ucspi-proxy prints messages about errors and byte counts.
